build_note: RFC first — empowered Frost Shot at max range procs Ranger's Focus (Q) for AOE slow. IE second (RFC 25% crit; IE 25% = 50% total before adding IE — need one more crit item first). Fix: RFC → Collector (50% total) → IE (75%, fully active). Ult any grouped fight from max range at fight start — it's free damage and disruption.
vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards mandatory — perma-slow keeps tanks in range for LDR procs
vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster — ISB + perma-slow = bait dive then shield
kit_notes: Q (Ranger's Focus) at max stacks: fires cone of arrows that AOE slow. Every auto is a slow. W (Volley) pokes and slows the entire ARAM corridor. Crystal Arrow (R) travels the full ARAM map — throw it at fight start from fountain for guaranteed hit. Hawkshot vision before fights.
aram_specific: R from fountain range hits any grouped ARAM fight. Never stand in melee range — RFC + max range Frost Shot means you can slow everything without being in danger. Q stack up before fights using minions, then dump on enemy frontline for AOE slow.
